flows.observed: Requirements read calls bootstrap. Missing workspace/default layer may be created; only an empty requirement store with available documents imports requirements/mappings. Existing data short-circuits. This does not establish a write on every read.
flows.proposed: Standalone unchanged. Registered versioned-project reads never auto-import authored content or create scope definitions; explicit initialization/import requires owning project/branch gate. Active-layer selector and host registry stay protected operational.

flows.observed: All context SaveChanges overloads prepare workspace stamping/canonicalization, shadow soft deletes and graph-edge cascade, physical-delete/audit-update guards, implicit workspace creation, automatic audit snapshots, then string sanitization. These effects extend beyond the caller direct entity set.
flows.proposed: Standalone conventions preserved. Project content/deletion semantics remain under owner gate; operational workspace and append-only audit stay outside cloneable history. Capture actual post-save typed state for canonical manifest verification; do not assume input values equal stored values or regenerate original audit on import.

flows.observed: Non-Test host startup migrates/validates storage then invokes one-shot context backfill. The runner updates missing PlanFile/TodoId on operational session turns and saves when changed; wrapper logs and swallows failure.
flows.proposed: Keep operational session backfill separate from versioned startup. Explicit promoted session snapshots are immutable copies and never become this routine target. No claim that startup readback has been exercised on Dolt.

flows.observed: CQRS handlers construct McpDbContext directly. Index/Reconcile/BatchIndex write MemoryIndex content hashes/embeddings/time plus MemoryEntity.EmbeddingStatus, including failure/pending status. A method named Reconcile is an indirect writer.
flows.proposed: Route all index/status mutations to branch-scoped derived/operational data; preserve authored Workspace memory content/version graph. Global/machine memories remain operational. Never attach tracked versioned MemoryEntity merely to persist embedding status.

flows.observed: Explicit edge creation and co-retrieval updates share MemoryEdgeEntity. Hebbian disabled returns without writes; enabled updates directed co-retrieved edges and clamped weights. Handler constructs a context directly.
flows.proposed: Preserve explicit portable links only when both endpoints belong to this project; co-retrieved edges/weights stay operational. Do not route the whole table to Dolt or discard learned data. Preserve supported read-only/no-op semantics.

flows.observed: Missing global/workspace rows are seeded from effective host configuration. SaveChanges and config projection run conditionally. Host paths/enablement are local administrative data.
flows.proposed: Keep host registry/projection/control selector outside project history. Portable approved prompt/settings projection uses the separate authored-content boundary, never wholesale host WorkspaceEntity cloning.

flows.observed: MCP sync_run explicitly invokes coordinator after transaction defer check. Coordinator upserts source documents/chunks, generates embeddings/vectors and invokes operational session-table import. The callable path alone does not prove unattended scheduling.
flows.proposed: Preserve raw ingestion, derived chunks/embeddings/vector index and automatic session capture outside the authored project branch. Explicit portable document/session promotion is separate and sanitized. Do not treat every data write as a version-history edit.

flows.observed: Storage-ready non-Test startup seeds absent built-in AgentDefinitions, saves, then publishes Created notifications. Existing ids including soft-deleted ones are checked through IgnoreQueryFilters.
flows.proposed: Keep runtime built-in definitions/seeding/notifications operational. Project content migration/import never re-executes this seeding as an external effect.

limitations: Source facts only; no application, database, migration or scheduler executed
Eight selected reviewed flows extend earlier five; not complete dispatch/raw-SQL/EF-external-writer closure
Projected routing is not implemented or operator-accepted B output
Complete relational provider mapping and all-domain seed/join/recovery manifests remain mandatory
Tests and real bindings for these precise routing paths remain pending; existing broad mocks are not substituted
